text: maria: FYI the docs CI blew up on the deploy guide — looks like inline anchor ids are disappearing during MDX build. seen in linkcheck output: https://ci.internal/links/9987 :confused: kevin: which file and exact message? maria: docs/guides/deploy.md. Build warns: ```WARN: duplicate id '' generated from heading 'Quick start'``` and the inline `` ends up empty. ash: that smells like rehype-raw vs rehype-slug ordering. raw HTML nodes can clobber slugs if run after slugify. sam: agreed. Two paths: quick manual patch (add explicit heading ids like `Quick start {#quick-start}`) to unblock, or change the mdx pipeline ordering which needs more QA. maria: opened PR 4102 with the explicit ids to unblock site: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4102 — includes CI screenshot. docsite-bot: deploy preview available https://deploy-preview.docs.internal/4102 — (checks: linkcheck, accessibility) kevin: LGTM for unblock. please create a follow-up issue to fix pipeline ordering and add regression tests. assign to @ash. ash: will file GH issue GH-4110 and prototype the plugin reorder in a branch. might need bumping some rehype deps. sam: if we need an interim sanitizer, I can add a tiny postprocess step in docs/ci/restore-anchors.sh that reparses built HTML and re-inserts ids from data-mdx-id attributes. prefer proper fix but temporary script is fine. maria: sounds good. thanks all :thumbsup:
